I don't have the Companion, which appears to have a cited article on "The Vileness."  Could someone confirm that the Companion explicitly states that "The Vileness" is a term "quietly used by some Aes Sedai"?  The only occurrence in the books is when Cadsuane refers to "that vileness after the Aiel War," and there's no indication that this is a proper or standard name.  If, for example, in the real world I demanded to know if someone had been part of "that awful business on January 6," then depending on context you would probably understand that I was referring to the storming of the United States Capitol.  But it wouldn't mean that "the Awful Business" is a name for that event.  (However, I unequivocally agree that "the Vileness" is a name widely in use out-of-universe.)  --[[User:DavidK93|DavidK93]] ([[User talk:DavidK93|talk]]) 04:50, 29 March 2021 (UTC)

: Yes, it does have it's own entry in the Companion. It was a fan term for many years, but it is officially called that in the Companion too. [[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin_2000]] ([[User talk:Moridin 2000|talk]]) 11:46, 29 March 2021 (UTC)
